edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, letting the deployer become admin.
require(msg.sender == admin) gates who may change the delegatecall implementation.
implementation_ overwrites the implementation state variable.
delegateToImplementation reads the implementation address as delegatecall target.
delegateAndReturn uses implementation as the delegatecall target.
delegateToImplementation forwards to delegateTo(implementation, data).
callee parameter is the target of the delegatecall.
data parameter supplies the raw calldata for the delegatecall.
delegateTo executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
callee.delegatecall(data) uses the caller-supplied callee address.
delegateAndReturn executes implementation.delegatecall(msg.data).
msg.data is delegatecalled into the stored implementation address.
delegateToViewAndReturn performs the staticcall operation.
delegateToViewImplementation performs the staticcall operation.
delegateToViewAndReturn staticcalls address(this) targeting delegateToImplementation.
delegateToViewImplementation staticcalls address(this) targeting delegateToImplementation.
allowResign controls whether _resignImplementation is delegatecalled.
becomeImplementationData is forwarded through delegateToImplementation.
_setImplementation delegatecalls _becomeImplementation on the new implementation.

The implementation delegatecall can call back into this contract, re-entering the fallback and delegateAndReturn with no active guard.
The unrestricted delegatecall in delegateTo can re-enter the contract via the fallback before state is settled.
delegateToImplementation is public and unguarded, so any msg.sender can trigger an arbitrary delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: implementation_ is only meaningful as the argument to the _setImplementation setter.
allowResign is a local control flag of _setImplementation.
oldImplementation is a transient cache used only inside _setImplementation.
callee is the delegatecall target supplied to the delegateTo helper.
data is the raw calldata operand of the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
success is the result flag of the unsafe delegatecall in delegateTo.
returnData is the bubbled returndata of the delegatecall in delegateTo.
data is the attacker-influenceable payload of delegateToImplementation.
data is the payload forwarded by delegateToViewImplementation.
success is the result flag of the implementation delegatecall in delegateAndReturn.
